description: Portable Plasma Accelerator Model Five, developed by Lockheed Martin Corporation.  Uses highly advanced capacitor banks to create a torus of superheated hydrogen plasma and accelerate it to incredible speed.  Consuming a large volume of hydrogen in exchange for anti-material firepower, it was expected to fully enter US Army service not long before the Cataclysm.

description: Boeing developed the focused plasma weaponry together with DARPA.  It heats solid hydrogen to create plasma and envelops it with polymers to reduce blooming.  While powerful, it suffers from short range.  Powered by UPS.
